defs.def: the son of your brother or sister; the son of your husband's or wife's brother or sister 侄子；外甥

ex.s: Even my nine-year-old niece and nephew know how to do them!
ex.t: 连我九岁的侄女和侄子都知道怎么做！

ex.s: His clerk, poor Bob Cratchit, was working, when Scrooge's nephew came in.
ex.t: 他的职员，可怜的鲍勃\u00b7克拉奇，正在工作，这时斯克鲁奇的侄子走了进来。

ex.s: Then he visited his nephew and stayed for Christmas dinner.
ex.t: 然后他去看望了他的侄子，并留下来吃了圣诞晚餐。

ex.s: (Adapted from “If I Were a Boy Again: A Plain Talk with My Nephews", by James Thomas Fields) Fill in the blanks with proper words.
ex.t: （改编自詹姆斯·托马斯·菲尔兹的《假如我又回到童年：与侄儿们的一次坦诚谈话》）用适当的词填空。

ex.s: It was my birthday dinner, a special treat, and the whole family were there-my parents, grandma, grandad, aunt, uncle and nephew.
ex.t: 那是我的生日晚餐，一次特别的款待，全家人都在——我的父母、奶奶、爷爷、阿姨、叔叔和侄子。
